title: Obvious group manipulations in voting
abstract: arXiv:2611.26224v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: We study obvious group manipulation in voting and characterize it as manipulation identifiable from a coalition's option sets alone. Our analysis focuses on two overlapping classes: tops-only rules and rules satisfying the majority criterion, including all Condorcet-consistent rules. On the universal domain with at least three alternatives, a tops-only rule is not obviously manipulable by groups (NOMG) if and only if it is dictatorial. For rules satisfying the majority criterion, NOMG is impossible when $n,m\geq3$, except with four voters and three alternatives. We quantify the coalition sizes behind these restrictions, obtaining sharp bounds for efficient tops-only rules and an exact threshold for majority-criterion rules with odd electorates. translated_title: 投票中的显性群体操纵
translated_abstract: 我们研究投票中的显性群体操纵，并将其刻画为仅凭联盟的选项集即可识别的操纵。我们的分析聚焦于两个相互重叠的规则类：仅依赖首位的规则以及满足多数准则的规则，后者包括所有孔多塞一致规则。在至少三个备选方案的全域上，仅依赖首位的规则不被群体显性操纵当且仅当它是独裁的。对于满足多数准则的规则，当 $n,m\geq3$ 时，NOMG 是不可能实现的，唯一的例外是四个选民与三个备选方案的情形。我们量化了这些限制背后的联盟规模，为有效的仅首位规则得到了紧的界，并为奇数选民情形下满足多数准则的规则得到了精确阈值。在这一例外情形中，我们刻画了一个包含波达计分的 NOMG 计分规则区间，该规则在此情形下也是孔多塞一致的。我们进一步刻画了两个备选方案下的 NOMG……（摘要原文在此处截断）
tldr: 本文刻画了投票规则“不被群体显性操纵”（NOMG）的成立条件：在至少三个备选方案下，仅首位规则不被群体显性操纵当且仅当它是独裁的，而满足多数准则的规则（含所有孔多塞一致规则）几乎必然可被群体显性操纵，唯一例外是四选民三方案情形，此时存在包含波达计分的 NOMG 计分规则区间。
en_tdlr: This paper characterizes when voting rules are not obviously manipulable by groups (NOMG): on the universal domain with at least three alternatives, a tops-only rule is NOMG if and only if it is dictatorial, while majority-criterion rules (including all Condorcet-consistent ones) are unavoidably group-manipulable except in the exceptional case of four voters and three alternatives, where an interval of NOMG scoring rules containing Borda exists.
